property_summary: For any nonzero amount passed to AdjustBetAmounts by the owner, the contract's public currentBetLimit() equals the same amount passed (reference); the mutant that sets betLimit = amount - 1 will make currentBetLimit() != amount for some inputs (any amount > 0).
change_summary: Replace betLimit assignment with setting betLimit to amount - 1 (underflow/checked by solidity will revert if amount == 0), altering observable bet limit after call.
